evidence.reference: tests/unit/railway-reconciliation.test.ts: discrepancy classification, no-overwrite, staleness, history

requirements.title: Resilience & degradation
requirements.behaviour: Circuit breaker (closed/open/half-open), exponential backoff with full jitter, request timeouts, TTL cache, graceful UNCONFIGURED/unknown degradation with honest statuses

evidence.reference: tests/unit/railway-client.test.ts resilience suite; Scenario G monitoring survives app outage

requirements.title: Tamper-evident audit trail
requirements.behaviour: Hash-chained (SHA-256, canonical JSON) append-only railway_audit table: id, timestamp, category, severity, resource, component, outcome, principal, redacted evidence; verify() detects modification AND deletion; no update/delete API exists

evidence.reference: tests/unit/railway-audit.test.ts: chain validity, tamper detection (UPDATE + DELETE), credential redaction at write time

requirements.title: Logical backup + isolated restore verification
requirements.behaviour: Full read-only export of all 24 NEXUS tables (sha256 per table) + REAL restore into an isolated in-memory database with row-exact comparison; tampering breaks verification; a backup that has never been restored is not claimed recoverable

evidence.reference: Scenario I: export -> isolated restore -> rowsMatched; tamper detected
tests/integration/railway-routes.test.ts: POST /railway/backup/export

requirements.title: Railway volume backup restore in production
requirements.behaviour: volumeInstanceBackupRestore is registered as an L4 operation; production restore requires owner authorization and is blocked by the read-only production protection

evidence.reference: tests/unit/railway-authorization.test.ts: operation registered L4, executable, owner-grant gated

blocker.limitation: Restoring a Railway volume backup in production is a destructive, irreversible operation on live data (wipe semantics) and cannot be performed under the production READ-ONLY restriction
blocker.technicalEvidence: Railway schema: volumeInstanceBackupRestore(volumeInstanceId!, volumeInstanceBackupId!, wipeServiceIds!, replicaServiceIds!) -> WorkflowId; backup reports honestly carry verified:false, recoverability:UNVERIFIED
blocker.minimumAdditionalCapability: Owner disables RAILWAY_READ_ONLY, grants railway.volume.backup.restore for a specific volume+backup pair, and the restore+verification executes against a disposable environment first
blocker.continuesIndependently: Yes — backup discovery, schedules, retention metadata and logical app-level backups (INFRA-22) are fully verified; only the production volume restore is blocked

requirements.title: Production deployment of the railway intelligence
requirements.behaviour: The @nexus/railway package and /railway routes are committed and fully tested in-repo; deploying them to the Railway production service is a production change that the directive explicitly gates on owner authorization

evidence.reference: full suite 162 pass / 0 fail incl. LIVE read-only verification against production Railway API

blocker.limitation: 'Keep production READ-ONLY. Do not deploy or modify production infrastructure without my explicit authorization' — deploying the new image would replace the running production deployment
blocker.technicalEvidence: railway.json auto-deploys from main; current production deployment SUCCESS (service Jarvis-Nexus, discovered live 2026-11-15); no deployment was triggered by this work
blocker.minimumAdditionalCapability: Owner authorization to push to main (auto-deploy) or a manual serviceInstanceRedeploy with the new image
blocker.continuesIndependently: Yes — the capability is live-verified from the repository against the real Railway API; only the production rollout awaits authorization

requirements.title: JARVIS architectural integration
requirements.behaviour: Railway intelligence is an integrated capability, not a dashboard: 20 HTTP routes (public status + owner-gated control plane), JARVIS ToolExecutor tools (read tools unconsequential; railway.recovery.execute consequential + dual-gated), health probe (fail-visible, non-blocking), memory scope 'railway' (tier operational), bounded metric labels, credential isolation from MCP/NAEI

evidence.reference: tests/integration/railway-routes.test.ts: 17-route 401 matrix, health component, tools registration/approval classes, intelligence Q&A
tests/unit/railway-diagnostics.test.ts: memory hook integration

requirements.title: End-to-end operational exercises
requirements.behaviour: Directive §17 Scenarios A-I exercised: A deployment-failure investigation, B app-outage independence, C credential failure (live garbage-token + previous-token probe), D discrepancy detection, E usage anomalies, F lost-event recovery, G monitoring independence, H authorized recovery loop (isolated) + read-only refusals, I backup restore verification

evidence.reference: tests/scenarios/railway-exercises.test.ts (12 tests) + live variants in railway-live.test.ts
